title: My Bathroom Door Has 1,024 LOCKS 🔒
description:
In our building, every door you close gets twice as many locks, and the locks never come off. So everyone keeps theirs wide open. I have never closed one in my life. My big sister Jade slams them, and we only have one bathroom.

This is how our bathroom door got to a thousand locks, and what finally happened to it.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SLAM if someone in your house slams every door.
